blurb: Graham Helicopters operates from bases in Kelowna, Campbell River, and Peace River. They provide helicopter services such as aerial firefighting, logging support, Kelowna helicopter tours, search and rescue, and remote ski lodge transfers. The company has been family-owned since 1996 and operates four helicopters including ASTAR B2, 206 L3, and 206 Longranger.
